title: LSV Fuel Soundings - vessel data (version 1)
description: Vessel data loaded privately into the app. The app validates this in calc.js (validateVesselData); this file documents the same rules.

distributionMarking.description: Distribution/handling marking shown in the app header (e.g. 'DISTRIBUTION C ...'). Empty string if the data is public.

source.description: Free-form provenance (workbook name, generated time, generator).

densityLbPerGal.description: Fuel density used for tons and as converter default (spreadsheet: 7.175).

waterLbPerGal.description: lb/gal = SG x this, in the converter.

trimVesselLengthFt.description: Length used in trim correction (spreadsheet: 272.75 ft LOA).

fuelTotalFillLimitPct.description: Used for 'Needed for N%' on the total-capacity basis (spreadsheet: 93).

lookup.description: floor = Excel approximate VLOOKUP (rounds down to the 0.25 in row); interpolate = linear between rows.

tanks.description: At least one tank must be type 'fuel'. Total fuel capacity = sum of the last table value of every fuel tank.

capacityGal.description: Used for percent full and needed-to-fill. null = no percent (e.g. bilge).

fillLimitPct.description: Per-tank fill limit for needed-to-fill (spreadsheet: 93 fuel/lube/hydraulic, 95 waste). Requires capacityGal.

unpumpableGal.description: Subtracted from total for 'usable' fuel (fuel tanks only).

trimCorrected.description: If true, the trim correction (inches) is added to the sounding before lookup.

maxIn.description: Highest sounding covered. Soundings below 0 or above maxIn show OUT OF RANGE.

gallons.description: Gallons at 0, 0.25, 0.5 ... maxIn inches (length = maxIn/0.25 + 1). Must not decrease.
